title: Hope you want to hold tightly
meaning: Your partnership can keep an inspiring hope alive when attachment to a desired future does not replace freedom in the present.
text: This overall energy field may combine restrained actions with a strong pull towards something desired. In the physical position, the High Priestess leaves time for observation: you need not turn each feeling into immediate action. In energy, the Devil describes a motive that can bind, as one possibility begins to seem like the only acceptable one. In emotions, the Star brings hope, a wish to support each other and a sense of continuation beyond present limits. A bright prospect does not automatically make an attachment free or guarantee an outcome.

For example, you dream of living beside the sea someday and browse property listings, although a decision remains distant. The conversation gives you both a sense of space, but other plans gradually lose their appeal beside this image. **Shared hope supports you while it does not have to take value away from life today.** A dream is a pleasure to share when it allows different continuations, rather than obliging you to want exactly the same thing forever.

The difficulty appears if faith in the future justifies increasingly tight restrictions now. You forgo available rest, meetings or small purchases because otherwise you seem disloyal to the dream. Support becomes a test of loyalty, and doubt prompts a defence of the plan. Trying to preserve inspiration, you make it burdensome. Hope remains generous when a changed wish can still be acknowledged.
